<b>Silk Hearts</b> are [[Items (Silksong)|Items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> that grant [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] automatic [[Silk]] regeneration.

== Use ==
{{Main|Silk}}
Each <b>Silk Heart</b> collected increases the cap of Silk that can be regenerated by 1 strand. There are 3 Silk Hearts that can be collected in total.

It takes 1.5 seconds for the first strand of Silk to regenerate, and 4.25 seconds for the other strands. Only 1 strand regenerates at a time. 
* This timer resets with any change in the amount of Silk held, including via striking enemies with the [[Needle]], falling in [[Muckmaggot]] water, and using [[Silk Skills]] and [[Tools]] that use Silk. This means that it is most effective during long periods between combat or when using normal Tools to avoid direct combat.

[[Weavelight]] reduces the regeneration time to 1 second for the first strand and a little more than 2.5 seconds for the others, and acts as an additional Silk Heart, allowing for a potential maximum of 4 strands. Sitting at a bench instantly regenerates all Silk produced by the Silk Hearts and Weavelight.
{{Clear}}

== How to Acquire ==
There are a total of 3 Silk Hearts, each granted upon defeating a boss.

Each Silk Heart forms hovering in the air, and the boss arena stays locked until it is collected. On touching it, Hornet is transported into a memory resembling the architecture of [[the Cradle]], where a platforming sequence must be completed to leave and obtain the Silk Heart. Dialogue within the memory is heavily implied to be from [[Grand Mother Silk]].
